_: The scenes, for the playground site (tools/site.cjs). `mix`: in the night mix on stream, in order. `t`: the second its thumbnail is taken at. `query`: added to the scene's URL. `by`: who made it, if not DEVSA.

scenes.title: The night bus
scenes.what: A long city bus rolls past Mission San José after dark, DEVSA's stickers in its windows.

scenes.title: Under the bridge
scenes.what: Glowing fish hang under the highway bridge on the Museum Reach, a wave of light rolling through them.

scenes.title: The game
scenes.what: A night game between two agents, from the introductions to the final buzzer.

scenes.title: The taco truck
scenes.what: Midnight at the Alamo Python taco truck: the penguin ships a feature at a folding table.

scenes.title: The Rand
scenes.what: PySanAntonio's mascot plays Houston Street while the Rand Building's windows run a light show.

scenes.title: Lotería at Market Square
scenes.what: A caller, three players and a deck of DEVSA's own cards under papel picado, with a conjunto under the lamp post.

scenes.title: San Fernando
scenes.what: A projection show mapped to the cathedral's stone, then DEVSA's conference films in the arch. Agents watch from folding chairs.

scenes.title: The River Walk
scenes.what: A river barge carries the penguin, the PySanAntonio mascot and three agents under the cypress lights.

scenes.title: The dome
scenes.what: The penguin's red roadster lifts off on the street by the Alamodome and flies past the masts.

scenes.title: The ride
scenes.what: The back seat of a driverless taxi, heading downtown toward the Tower.

scenes.title: The starter
scenes.what: The template. Copy it to start your own scene: it explains the three layers in its comments.
